description: FCM push tokens + send helper (extends notifications)

ops.content:
model UserPushToken {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid()) @map("id")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  userId     String   @map("user_id")
  token      String   @unique @map("token")
  platform   String   @map("platform")
  deviceId   String?  @map("device_id")
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([userId, isActive])
  @@map("user_push_tokens")
}

messages: Set FCM_PROJECT_ID, FCM_CLIENT_EMAIL, FCM_PRIVATE_KEY for push
Register token from mobile, then notifications.send({ push: true })
